profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer, iOS @ The Knot Worldwide | Swift, SwiftUI
profile.summary:
Lead iOS engineer with a decade of Swift experience, from the language's earliest releases through today's SwiftUI and concurrency model. My career has spanned connected hardware (Apple Watch, smart thermostats, a connected BBQ grill) and consumer apps at scale, with a throughline of caring deeply about how an app feels to use.
At The Knot Worldwide, I co-lead an iOS chapter across our Ecom and Guest product areas and sit on the AI Dev Champions working group, where I help shape how our engineering org adopts AI tooling. My focus there is practical. How do we make AI an engine for engineers who want to use it? How do we judge adoption by outcomes that actually matter, like cycle time, defect rates, and developer experience, instead of vanity metrics? How do we build the trust and practice surface that lets senior engineers adopt these tools on their own terms?

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, iOS
positions.description:
• Sole iOS engineer on the payments path, a revenue-critical initiative: shipped Venmo checkout end to end, owning technical design, delivery, and release quality.

• Member of the AI Dev Champions working group, shaping engineering-wide AI adoption strategy with the CTO, VPs, and peer leads.

• Built a project-scoped install layer for the org's shared AI tooling catalog, so any team can adopt reusable skills without redoing setup.

• Authored AI tooling plugins for the shared catalog, including a design-system plugin that keeps AI-generated code on-spec, plus a tool that surfaces live Copilot usage.

• Pushed the group to define success by outcomes that matter (keep rate, PR cycle time, post-merge defect rate) rather than activity counts.

• Co-lead the Ecom/Guest iOS chapter and run a monthly engineering-news segment.
positions.insights: Skills: Large Language Models (LLMs) · Cross-functional Collaborations · Product Development · Mentoring · REST APIs · Swift Concurrency · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Technical Leadership · Crashlytics / Firebase · GitHub Copilot · AI-Assisted Development · Swift (Programming Language) · Code Review · Developer Experience (DX)

positions.title: Staff iOS Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Used AI to compress a Realm to GRDB migration from a multi-month effort to 3 weeks, eliminating a deprecated dependency.
• Led SwiftUI adoption and a full app modernization as technical lead, owning architecture and code-review standards.
• Rewrote the Apple Watch app on the latest SDKs and shipped a full redesign and rebrand with product and design, from minimal specs.

projects.title: Branch: Thermostat Control
projects.description: Branch enabled users to control their Nest Thermostat from iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, and Today Extension. I built it out of a desire to control my Nest from my Apple Watch and it grew from there, shipping to paying customers across all of Apple's platforms with a 4-star App Store rating."

projects.title: ConvoSpot - iOS App
projects.description: The way the app works is anyone can post messages and if someone is within 100 meters of you, they can see your message and you can see what they send. Also, messages fade away and after 30 minutes are deleted from both the app and the database, so there's some security that what you say will not be there forever.
